correctness.rationale: The exact sign-ring enumeration constructs all D/I polyhedral edges, all great-circle vertices and Euler region counts, and one strictly realizable sign mask per cell. Counts agree independently with Euler for D=92, I=32, union=152, yielding exhaustive 60/20/60/12 joint class counts. Updated checker also enumerates the exact exterior-turn algebraic cosine multisets for every D and I chamber (not just sample cases). Gauss–Bonnet then gives all four probability formulas, whose normalized sum is exactly one by symbolic cancellation. Exceptional normals have zero area; no finite Monte Carlo extrapolation.

value.rationale: One common random central plane cutting a polar Platonic pair is a natural coupled stereological experiment. Marginals known separately do not determine incidence. The exact 16-circle refinement establishes an unexpectedly rigid forbidden-state relation, proves each of the 20 hexagonal normal chambers splits into one 12-type plus three 10-type triangles, and gives the complete joint distribution as a reusable building block for correlated sections, beyond tabulating individual existing spherical areas.
